description: This source file defines the GrainVersionStore class, which implements version management functionalities for grains within the Orleans distributed framework. It provides methods to set and retrieve compatibility and selector strategies for grain interfaces, managing interactions through an internal grain grainFactory and integrating with the silo lifecycle.

classes.name: GrainVersionStore
classes.description: Implements version store operations for grains, managing compatibility and version selection strategies, and participating in the silo lifecycle.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for grains, optionally for a specific interface type.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the version selector strategy for grains, optionally for a specific interface type.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStrategies
methods.description: Retrieves all configured compatibility strategies mapped by grain interface type.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategies
methods.description: Retrieves all configured selector strategies mapped by grain interface type.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the current default compatibility strategy.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the current default selector strategy.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the store to the silo lifecycle for initialization.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Initializes the store, setting the enabled state based on available services.
